Name: SOLAR ANNIHILATION
Overview: SOLAR ANNIHILATION by reddeathgames is a 2d space shooter. Explore a dynamic 2d solar system while completing missions ranging from seek and destroy to stealth and resource gathering. Sandbox elements allow player to go anywhere at anytime. Full game contains 18 mission campaign, instant action mode, and cheat options. The game will sell for 80 microsoft points or about $1.00 U.S. and contains around 2 hours of gameplay.
